title: pretty ASPYN|Plus Size Pleated Waist Applique Maxi Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
This plus-size chiffon maxi dress combines timeless elegance with a touch of romance. The pleated waist creates a flattering, defined silhouette, while delicate applique detailing adds a refined, feminine touch. The soft chiffon fabric flows effortlessly, making it perfect for formal events where you want both comfort and style.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves


Closure: Concealed zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded enough for "no bra" option, with lining.


Fabric: The garment comprises chiffon


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch
